verses.73:14: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَثِيبࣰ ا مَّهِيلًا

meaning: The root هيل (hyl) primarily describes something pouring down, like sand. It also refers to a wall collapsing or crumbling into pieces.
